anchor.semantic_hook: Addressing every woman and every man is staged as two complete, equal seating arcs reached together from one shared speaking circle.
anchor.setting: A multipurpose civic hall has two equal semicircles of empty chairs facing a circular speaking area, with a lectern, classroom tables, and cleaning supplies nearby. One enormous unbroken stone ribbon rises from the floor, curves unsupported behind every chair, and joins both seating arcs in a complete embrace.
anchor.absurd_element: an enormous unsupported stone ribbon embracing every chair in both seating arcs
